issues.description: ClaimReview JSON-LD in generate-html.js (line 1513) uses ${counts.total} (our WIN count, currently 72) in the "claimReviewed" field, where it should use ${context.domeClaimedConfirmed} (the dome's own claimed count, 69). This misrepresents what the dome claims: "The dome has 72 confirmed predictions" vs the correct "The dome claims 69 confirmed predictions." The ClaimReview schema is meant to represent the claim being reviewed (dome's own claim), not our entry count.
issues.suggested_fix: In build-scripts/generate-html.js line 1513, change: "claimReviewed": "The Ovoid Cavity Cosmological Model has ${counts.total} confirmed predictions with ${failures.dome_claimed_accuracy} accuracy" → "claimReviewed": "The Ovoid Cavity Cosmological Model has ${context.domeClaimedConfirmed} confirmed predictions with ${failures.dome_claimed_accuracy} accuracy"

issues.title: WIN-042 detail_evidence citation-support mismatch: ~30 nT/14-months parenthetical contradicts long-run-rate claim
issues.description: WIN-042.c5 hole 2: The merged sentence reads "met at SAA-core stations on the long-run rate (the dome own regional confirmation cites ~30 nT over 14 months)" but 30*12/14=25.7 nT/yr < 28 nT/yr threshold — the parenthetical offered in support of the long-run-rate claim actually shows the threshold NOT being met. The intended logic (multi-year long-run station rates exceed 28; the dome specific 14-month window does not) is sound but the in-line evidence undercuts it. Fix: support the long-run-rate claim with a multi-year source (INTERMAGNET/CHAOS-7 station rates or the dome station-table values), keep the 14-month/25.7 arithmetic as a separate sentence attacking the dome confirmation window.
issues.routing_reason: Moderate citation-support mismatch; fold into analyst EXP for WIN-042 precision fix
